about: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B NVFP4 as miaai-lab runs it (MiaAI-Lab/Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-DGX-Spark)
entrypoint:
rm -f /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nvidia/nccl/lib/libnccl.so.2 2>/dev/null
ln -sf /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libnccl.so.2 /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nvidia/nccl/lib/libnccl.so.2 2>/dev/null
FAR=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm/distributed/device_communicators/flashinfer_all_reduce.py
sed -i 's/^except ImportError:/except Exception:/' "$FAR" 2>/dev/null
CIPC=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/flashinfer/comm/cuda_ipc.py
sed -i 's/if lib_name in line:/if lib_name in line and "stub" not in line:/' "$CIPC" 2>/dev/null
exec vllm serve ...
setup: Download the model on the host first (hf download nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B-NVFP4); HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. start.sh picks the first snapshot dir under ~/.cache/huggingface/hub and replaces symlinked *.py/*.json/*.jinja in it with real files so trust_remote_code loads. Mounts ~/.cache/huggingface and ~/.cache/flashinfer -> /root/.cache/flashinfer. In-container prelude relinks aarch64 system libnccl and seds two FlashInfer compatibility fixes (all-reduce ImportError -> Exception, cuda_ipc skip stub libs).
